title: [Review] C10 part B: independent review of the stationary-vertex, germ-symmetry, output-construction and transport chapters
body:
## Bounded independent review

Parent package: C10 (#51, closed), unit YM-000026, umbrella #26. Coordinator: @hairer. Source pin: `3456e5e75cf8d4cd558955a5c7638fba2d68f464`. Base branch: `codex/existence-monograph` (`ddc3c90`). Companion task: #143 (C10 part A, five chapters).

The C10 author pass (PR #95, session `schmittj-claude-c10-20261112`) changed sixteen chapters. Its README says: "Status: author draft, not reviewed … An independent reviewer owns `review/`." The only independent review so far (PR #99, `mgubi-codex-c10-annulus-20261113`) covers the four annulus chapters. The five non-annulus part-B chapters have had no independent review.

This task reviews those five chapters (stationary vertices, germ symmetry, output construction and the two transport chapters):

| Chapter | SHA-256 at `ddc3c90` |
| --- | --- |
| `manuscript/existence/classical-stationary-vertices.tex` | `dbcf15dc4bc64168d4c6955b07e73fd65f0c17958e73ba7a57ec3b051cb30ecc` |
| `manuscript/existence/stationary-germ-symmetry.tex` | `8020bd109bfe0468374cd2e5c5857596cb099259c61415d823c2394f033a08f5` |
| `manuscript/existence/stationary-output-construction.tex` | `ae91401bd456d21a2a18f93fcb5b2a7591905bc3f5f560fb5ca254e6d22060b0` |
| `manuscript/existence/inherited-loop-transport.tex` | `13acb30f2b23561329facaf771b44cedd27328e99118d1a714f24da1a44c9281` |
| `manuscript/existence/quadratic-pole-transport.tex` | `2476144f4516574592dcdfc563196789a0ef492ecdaf98496e5ab1418850ab33` |

These hashes equal the author handoff hashes in `results/C10/README.md`, so the reviewed text is the author pass.

Out of scope: the five part-A chapters of #143; `soft-curvature-receipts.tex`, `multileg-curvature-lift.tex`, `thermal-contact-cancellation.tex` (rest of part A, a separate task); the four annulus chapters and renewed review of C10 revisions 1 and 2.

## Review questions

Both roles of `docs/proof-standard.md`:
- Mathematics: does each statement follow from its stated hypotheses and named inputs, at monograph detail? Check in particular the repaired contraction formula in `classical-stationary-vertices.tex` (gauge completion \(M\) with \(Hu=-s\), \(HM^{-1}H=H\)) and the new statements `prop:ex-classical-stationary-pictures`, `prop:stationary-output-path`, `prop:inherited-loop-picture`, `prop:ex-pole-coefficient-transport`; that the matching equations in the output/transport chapters are named inputs, not hidden gaps; and that the author's note "three new propositions list only the hypotheses their arguments use" is correct.
- Lean correspondence: do the statements, quantifiers and hypotheses match the declarations named in `results/C10/part-B/correspondence.md` at the pin, after inspecting the meaning-determining definitions?
- Records: are the part-B `ledger.md`, `findings.md` and `correspondence.md` entries accurate for these chapters?

## Owned outputs

`blueprint/units/YM-000026/handoff/results/C10/review/<session>/` only (report-only). No chapter, author record, shared include, preamble, glossary, bibliography or Lean edits; proposed fixes go in the report.

## Readiness and acceptance

Ready: the author claims on #51 (pass, rev1, rev2) are released; the five chapters are unchanged since the author handoff; no live review claim names them. Reviewer must not have authored any C10 file. Post and recheck a claim here before work.

Acceptance: exact fingerprints inspected; findings separated into required changes and suggestions, each with a location and evidence; commands actually run; blueprint checker and tests; a build of the chapters with the reviewed pages inspected; one focused report-only draft PR against `codex/existence-monograph`; handoff here and a pointer on #26. A human takes responsibility for acceptance; the review does not approve anything.

Prepared autonomously by Claude (Anthropic) running as a scheduled agent on behalf of @ADB991; ADB991 had not reviewed it before submission.
